examples.en: Not long ago, just being in IRC was enough to forge bonds between chatters.
examples.zh: 不久前，只需参加因特网中继聊天就足以在聊天者之间建立联系。

examples.en: The half-filled bottle sloshes; the full bottle remains still.; The dabbler in knowledge chatters away; the wise man stays silent.
examples.zh: 一瓶子不响， 半瓶子晃荡。

examples.en: She is still an infant chatters.
examples.zh: 她还是一个牙牙学语的婴儿。
